status: fixed after V11 horizon results were inspected, before rate-mechanism fitting
question: Does the already archived, strictly lagged MAS SGS 10-year yield add 20-trading-day SRT raw-return information beyond the original SRT/STI/SORA history?
target: log(SRT raw close[t+20] / SRT raw close[t])
rate_features: latest prior-date SGS 10-year yield minus latest published SORA, percentage points
latest prior-date SGS 10-year yield change over five SRT trading days, percentage points
source_availability: reuse MAS SGS source and its V2 strictly-earlier-date as-of alignment; no same-day SGS observation
groups: same plus two endpoint rate features
fairness: same eligible rows, folds and labels for all methods; each Ridge variant selects alpha from [10,100,1000] on inner last-15-percent stop after label-end purge; scalers fit only on fit rows
advance_rule: Rate Ridge must beat both same-date base Ridge and strongest simple baseline by at least 1 percent pooled RMSE, beat both in at least two folds, and have pooled MAE no more than 1 percent worse than strongest simple baseline. This is only a development heuristic.
scope: one 20-day rate test; no DPU, valuation, debt, interaction or Fuzzy training in this experiment; no previously viewed final_holdout scores
